register.labelZh: PEEL 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: PEEL 片語動詞可以描述牆紙翹起、油漆剝落,或衣物上的印刷圖案脫落。；游泳、運動或淋雨後,衣物可能會黏着身體。PEEL OFF 可以生動地表達把這些衣物脫下。；你可以用 PEEL 表達揭下食物包裝、瓶上的標籤或螢幕上的保護膜。；當某人揭起地氈、牆紙或紙張,以查看下面的地板、牆身或文字時,可以使用 PEEL BACK。
register.summaryEn: PEEL expressions can describe wallpaper lifting from a wall, paint separating from a door or a printed picture disappearing from a shirt. After swimming, exercise or heavy rain, clothes may stick to the body. PEEL OFF gives a clear picture of pulling those clothes away. You can peel a wrapper off some food, peel a label off a bottle or peel protective film off a screen. PEEL BACK is useful when a person lifts a layer to see what is underneath, such as a floor, a wall or hidden writing.

fixedVariable.variableZh: 保留原句中的人物、事物、時間、地點和意思。；名詞通常可以放在兩個位置;但使用 it、him、her 或 them 時,須把代名詞放在 PEEL 和 OFF 中間。；FROM + 地方屬於補充資料,用來說明表層從哪個表面剝離。當表面已經清楚時,可以省略FROM 部分。；PEEL AWAY/BACK 和 PEEL OFF 有時都可以描述表層剝離。本練習會利用完整情境,讓你分辨牆紙或表層翹起、一般剝落、脫下濕衣物,以及揭下包裝或標籤等不同用法。
fixedVariable.variableEn: Keep the same people, things, time, place and meaning. A noun can often appear in either position: peel the label off peel off the label However, it, him, her and them must appear in the middle: peel it off peel them off FROM + a place is additional information. It tells us which surface the layer is separating from: The wallpaper began to peel away. The wallpaper began to peel away from the wall. When the surface is already clear, the phrase beginning with FROM is optional. PEEL AWAY/BACK and PEEL OFF can sometimes describe similar surface damage. In this exercise: ● PEEL AWAY/BACK is used when a layer lifts back, remains partly attached or reveals what is underneath. ● PEEL OFF is used for the more general idea of a layer separating from a surface. ● PEEL SOMETHING OFF can describe removing wet or tight clothes. ● PEEL SOMETHING OFF SOMETHING can describe removing a wrapper, label, sticker or covering.
